cases.source: The council decided to help the port seek a loan. Negotiations were still pending at the end of the month.
cases.candidate: 议会成功促成港口贷款。
cases.reason: 把争取贷款的决定升级成已完成结果，并遗漏谈判仍在进行。

cases.source: The new crane did not improve total delivery time because the exit gate remained congested.
cases.candidate: 新吊机改善了整体交付速度。
cases.reason: 遗漏否定，并把局部设备能力与整体交付混淆。

cases.source: The manager claimed the strike alone caused the delay. The report disputes this, citing earlier maintenance failures.
cases.candidate: 报告认为延迟完全由罢工引起。
cases.reason: 将经理的主张错误归给持反对意见的报告作者。

cases.source: Traffic rose after the bridge opened. Yet journeys became slower because the new traffic overwhelmed the connecting road.
cases.candidate: 大桥开放后，交通流量增加。
cases.reason: 单条事实正确，但漏掉流量增加导致连接道路拥堵这一关键机制。

cases.source: For refrigerated cargo only, the shortcut reduced travel time. Dry cargo still used the old road.
cases.candidate: 捷径缩短了冷藏货物的运输时间；该结论不适用于仍走旧路的干货。
cases.reason: 事实、对象范围与限制均保留。
